title: Tensor evaluation of the normalized compactification graph
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $e:V\to T$ a separated etale finite-type morphism between Noetherian schemes. Choose a compactification $c=(j:V\hookrightarrow Z,r:Z\to T)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Work on the ordinary small etale sites in unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Let $N$ be a graph- and homotopy-normalized compact-support comparison [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization]. Put $S=D(e_{\Sigma!})$, $E=D(e^*)$, $O=D(j_!)$, $P=Lr^*$ and $R=Rr_*$. Write $t_M=(N.comparison(e,c))^{-1}_M:SM\to ROM$, and let $d_M:PSM\to OM$ be its transpose under $P\dashv R$. Write $\eta$ for the unit of $S\dashv E$, and $\theta_{X,K}:EX\otimes^L EK\xrightarrow{\sim}E(X\otimes^L K)$ for the canonical exact-pullback tensor comparison [lem-asd-etale-sum-extension-tensor]. For all $M\in D(V,A)$, $K\in D(T,A)$ and $q:S(M\otimes^L EK)\to SM\otimes^L K$ satisfying $\eta_{M\otimes^L EK}E(q)=(\eta_M\otimes1)\theta_{SM,K}$, the following composite equals $d_{M\otimes^L EK}$: apply $P(q)$, then the canonical comparison $P(SM\otimes^L K)\to PSM\otimes^L PK$, then $d_M\otimes1$, then the inverse open projection $OM\otimes^L PK\to O(M\otimes^L Lj^*PK)$ [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], then $O(1\otimes\lambda_K)$ and $O(1\otimes\iota_K)$. Here $\lambda:Lj^*Lr^*\cong Le^*$ is canonical pullback composition and $\iota:Le^*\cong E$ is the exact/left-derived comparison [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. There is no boundedness assumption.

proof.text: The sheaf and homotopy normalization equations identify d with descended graph evaluation. On a K-injective resolution of the open extension this follows from ordinary counit naturality. The unit equation for q uniquely specifies the reverse sum tensor mate.

On a local tensor generator (s,m) tensor k both evaluation composites retain m tensor s-star k on the clopen graph of s and vanish on its complement. The sheaf axiom on this disjoint open cover, linearity, inverse-image locality and module sheafification imply equality on sheaves. The unit equation identifies q as the inverse of the sum projection sending (s,m) tensor k to (s,m tensor s-star k).

Choose flat-term K-flat models separately on V and T. Sum extension and open extension preserve these models; inverse image preserves their flatness. Totalize the equality in every bidegree. All maps have degree zero and preserve tensor-factor order, so the signed differentials agree. The canonical derived pullback tensor and open projection comparisons identify these chain maps with the displayed derived maps.

Extend equality of the natural families through the K-flat localization presentation, first in the V variable and then in the T variable. Uniqueness of localization descent gives equality on every pair of unbounded derived objects. Homotopy normalization fixes d and the adjunction unit equation fixes q throughout.

theorem compactSupportGraph_tensor_evaluation
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T]
    (e : V ⟶ T) [Etale e] [IsSeparated e]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e] (c : Compactification e)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    let S : DerivedCategoryModule A V ⥤ DerivedCategoryModule A T :=
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
    let E : DerivedCategoryModule A T ⥤ DerivedCategoryModule A V :=
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).mapDerivedCategory
    let O : DerivedCategoryModule A V ⥤ DerivedCategoryModule A c.Z :=
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory
    let P : DerivedCategoryModule A T ⥤ DerivedCategoryModule A c.Z :=
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).leftDerivedFunctor
    let adj := derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g
    let d : ∀ X : DerivedCategoryModule A V, P.obj (S.obj X) ⟶ O.obj X := fun X ↦
      (adj.homEquiv (S.obj X) (O.obj X)).symm ((N.comparison e c).inv.app X)
    let sumAdj := (etaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e
      inferInstance).mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction
    ∀ q : S.obj (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).obj (E.obj K)) ⟶
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj (S.obj M)).obj K,
      sumAdj.unit.app _ ≫ E.map q =
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).map (sumAdj.unit.app M)).app (E.obj K) ≫
          (etaleSumExtensionTensorPullbackIso A e (S.obj M) K).hom →
      P.map q ≫
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g).app (S.obj M)).app K ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.Z).map (d M)).app (P.obj K) ≫
        ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).inv.app M).app (P.obj K) ≫
        O.map (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).map
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarCompactificationIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).hom.app K)) ≫
        O.map (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).map
          ((leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).hom.app K)) =
      d (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).obj (E.obj K))
